d:
我看網路上有關奶希的太少了，於是就自己拜託別人在本地跑了一些，用的SD整合包。畫風的LoRa也是客製化的。是我自己喜歡的風格，如果您覺得不符合您的胃口那很抱歉
由於是AI生成的難免有一些問題，請見諒
---------------------------------------------
I saw there's too little content about Velinoa (Honkai Impact 3rd) online, so I asked someone to run some on my PC using an SD integrated package. The art style LoRA was also custom-made. It's a style I personally like. If you feel it doesn't suit your taste, I'm sorry, and this set of images may not be for you.
Since these are AI-generated, there are inevitably some issues. Please forgive me.
